square_id.description: Unique dedupe key: Square payment ID, tender ID, refund ID or payout ID

entry_kind.description: Kind of ledger entry (owner revamp Oct 3 2026: sale->collected, payout->card_spend; card_topup added Oct 3 2026 for fund transfers onto the Square Cards — payout records at card (MOBILE) locations, destination SQUARE_STORED_BALANCE)

tender_type.description: Tender used for sales: CARD, CASH, SQUARE_ACCOUNT, OTHER (null for non-sales)

sale_class.description: cod_collection is set at sync time (delivery link). card_spend/other_sale are derived at render time from card labels; stored value may be null

amount_cents.description: Absolute amount in cents (sign is derived from classification at render time)

folder_cents.description: Folder (savings) contribution in cents: round(amount_cents x folder_rate). Null for non-sale rows

loan_cents.description: Loan repayment in cents: round(amount_cents x loan_rate for the location). Null for non-sale rows

settled_cents.description: Net returned to the card: amount_cents - fee_cents - folder_cents - loan_cents. Null for non-sale rows

status.description: Raw Square status: COMPLETED, FAILED, PENDING, CANCELED, REJECTED, PAID, SENT, IN_PROGRESS, etc

occurred_at.description: True UTC ISO timestamp of the event from Square

location_name.description: Resolved friendly name from SquareLocationConfig at sync time

delivery_id.description: Linked RxDeliver delivery ID when the sale/refund belongs to a collected COD (nullable)

patient_id.description: Patient ID from the linked COD catalog item (nullable)

cod_item_name.description: COD catalog item name when linked (nullable)

refund_of_payment_id.description: For refunds: the payment ID that was refunded (nullable)

refund_of_square_id.description: For refunds: ledger square_id of the refunded entry, when known (nullable)

reason.description: Refund reason / decline details / payout destination+type / card_topup source summary (nullable)

card_brand.description: Card brand, e.g. VISA, MASTERCARD, INTERAC (nullable)

entry_method.description: Card entry method: SWIPED, CHIP, CONTACTLESS, KEYED (nullable)

synced_at.description: ISO timestamp when this record was last synced from Square

attributed_location_id.description: For card_topup rows: the STORE location_id whose sale fed the card (resolved from the payout's CHARGE entry payment). Null when the transfer source is not a sale (e.g. folder/card-to-card manual transfer).
